name: Aggregate
summary: A cluster of entities and value objects treated as one unit for the purpose of data changes, with a single root that everything outside the boundary must go through.

roles.name: Root
roles.summary: The single entity by which the aggregate is referenced from outside, and the only participant allowed to enforce the invariants that span the boundary.

roles.name: Member
roles.summary: A participant living inside the boundary, reachable only through the root and never referenced by anything outside it.
